title: arifOS Resource Manifest
description: The contract every entry in 01_RESOURCES/ must satisfy. Forged 2026-08-15 by F13 SOVEREIGN directive. RRR-native: discovers, never thinks, never judges, never executes.

id.description: Reverse-domain resource identifier. The 'arifos://' namespace is canonical; external sources use their own prefix (mcp://, fastmcp://, a2a://, openclaw://).

type.description: The kind of resource this entry represents.

state.description: Lifecycle state. STALE is set by the freshness probe when the resource is no longer reachable.

freshness.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last successful freshness probe. Diff against 'now' must be ≤ epoch-freshness tolerance.

owner.description: The actor responsible for this resource. F13 sovereign, an arifOS lane (333/555/777/888), or an external owner.

epoch.description: The version of reality this resource reflects. Paired with freshness.

epistemic_label.description: F2 epistemic label. OBS=observed; DER=derived; INT=interpreted; SPEC=specular; UNKNOWN=non-claim.

links.description: Inbound + outbound links. Each is a relationship edge in the love-link graph.

canonical.description: Canonical URL for the upstream source.

implements.description: Resources this entry implements or conforms to.

requires.description: Resources this entry requires. Each must reciprocate with 'required_by'.

provides.description: Resources this entry provides. Each must reciprocate with 'provided_by'.

love_links.description: Bidirectional relationships. Target must have a matching love_link back. The verifier refuses to admit unpaired love-links.

derived_from.description: EUREKA / SCAR lineage. Used by the propagation chain.

invalidated_by.description: Newer resources that supersede this one.

scope.description: Declared side effects. Tighter than required ↔ softer than required.

freshness_tolerance_seconds.description: Maximum acceptable drift before the resource is marked STALE.

reversible.description: F1 AMANAH. If false, the resource is IRREVERSIBLE and requires F13 sign-off.

constitutional_floors.description: F1-F13 floors this resource is bound to. Mandatory: at least F1 (AMANAH) and F11 (AUDITABILITY).

checksum.description: SHA-256 of the canonical source. Optional but recommended for ACTIVE resources.

epoch_of_last_mutation.description: The epoch this resource was last mutated. The freshness probe uses this + delta to know when re-load is needed.
